product_summary: Vercel is an American cloud platform company that provides a frontend cloud for building, deploying, and hosting web applications. It is the creator and maintainer of the open-source React framework Next.js, and its platform offers Git-based deployments, a global edge network, preview environments, serverless and edge functions, and observability tooling. Vercel also ships an AI SDK and AI-oriented infrastructure for developers building AI-powered apps.
